job_1409912_fidelity_classification.rationale: Loading history uses Step-1 (u=0.005, 500 incs) and Step-2 (u=0.010, 1000 incs), which differs from literal publication text and standard baseline displacement. Job continues execution safely on cluster to serve as a valuable layered diagnostic variant.

submission_decision_gate.rationale: Because the published pre-analysis loading schedule contains self-contradictory displacement values (Delta u1=10^-3 for 500 increments implies u=0.5 mm) and omits exact step names and frame selection, no single unambiguous loading correction exists. Constructing and submitting a speculative variant is prohibited under project governance.
